note: Three deterministic structure hypotheses, not newly trained AI. Reused dates, separate stock accounts; no independent future proof or book history.

rules.bounce: low in support [-0.3,+0.15] prior ATR, green close >=support+0.3 ATR, previous close >=support+0.15 ATR
rules.costs: v1 five bps fees and five bps slippage each side; normal and doubled costs
rules.events: prior confirmed level, prior ATR, adjacent same-day candles; latest candle never creates its own prior level
rules.limitations: previously examined history; no trained book/news/trader identity; no real fills/taxes
rules.pivot: strict local high/low of five contiguous positive-volume same-MSK-day candles; available only after right two bars close
rules.replay: v1 next-open LONG, initial 1.5ATR/min0.3% stop, exit within four contiguous bars, unknown future retained
rules.trend_filter: close above EMA50 and EMA50 rising over three bars

variants.support_bounce: Отскок от подтверждённого минимума + тренд + объём
